## Render a presentation with the movement profile {data-style-preview="movement"}

<span class="kicker">Reproduce</span>

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_gallery_plots.py
quarto render --profile color-movement
```

::: {#algorithm-gallery-movement-render .algorithm-caption}
**Algorithm.** Rebuild the illustrative figures, then render the Movement style gallery to `_site/index.html`.
:::

::: {.profile-checklist}
1. Render with the intended color profile.
2. Regenerate figures after changing data.
3. Inspect contrast, overflow, captions, and offline assets.
:::
